comparisons.peer_summary: Citigroup routinely faces various legal actions, proceedings, and regulatory examinations globally, which may involve claims for substantial damages or injunctive relief across multiple jurisdictions with differing legal regimes.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citigroup (C) disclose that they are subject to ongoing regulatory investigations, reviews, and subpoenas from governmental and self-regulatory bodies as part of their ordinary business operations. GS details specific areas under scrutiny, such as securities offering processes, investment management, and municipal securities trading, while C provides a broader overview of routine examinations and information-gathering requests across its various regulated entities, including its role as a bank and broker-dealer. Both disclosures highlight the pervasive nature of regulatory scrutiny in the financial sector.

sentences.text: • The securities offering process and underwriting practices;
• The firm's investment management and financial advisory services;

• Transactions involving government-related financings and other matters, municipal securities, including wall-cross procedures and conflict of interest disclosure with respect to state and municipal clients, the trading and structuring of municipal derivative instruments in connection with municipal offerings, political contribution rules, municipal advisory services and the possible impact of credit default swap transactions on municipal issuers;

In the ordinary course of business, Citigroup and Related Parties also are subject to governmental and regulatory examinations, information-gathering requests, investigations and proceedings (both formal and informal), certain of which may result in adverse judgments, settlements, fines, penalties, restitution, disgorgement, injunctions or other relief.

In connection with formal and informal inquiries by these regulators, Citigroup and such affiliates and subsidiaries receive numerous requests, subpoenas and orders seeking documents, testimony and other information in connection with various aspects of their regulated activities.

peer_results.rationale: The candidate disclosures (jpm_2024_8_D542, jpm_2024_8_D605) cover intercompany lending restrictions under federal law and shareholder litigation related to historical trading resolutions, respectively. Neither addresses the general scope of ongoing governmental and regulatory investigations and reviews of current business practices as described in the target disclosure.

comparisons.peer_topic: General litigation and regulatory proceedings overview
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm faces various legal actions and regulatory investigations in the normal course of business, including claims for substantial or indeterminate damages, involving areas such as antitrust, false claims, wealth management, sales and trading, and capital markets.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley (MS) faces various legal actions and regulatory investigations in the normal course of business. Both disclosures emphasize that these proceedings can involve claims for substantial or indeterminate damages. While GS lists specific functional areas under regulatory review (e.g., research practices, municipal securities), MS highlights the types of legal claims and business lines involved (e.g., antitrust, wealth management, sales and trading), confirming a shared exposure to broad regulatory and litigation risks inherent in global diversified financial services.

sentences.text: • Research practices, including research independence and interactions between research analysts and other firm personnel, including investment banking personnel, as well as third parties;

In addition to the matters described below, in the normal course of business, the Firm has been named, from time to time, as a defendant in various legal actions, including arbitrations, class actions and other litigation, arising in connection with its activities as a global diversified financial services institution.
Certain of the actual or threatened legal actions include claims for substantial compensatory and/or punitive damages or claims for indeterminate amounts of damages.
